criteria.requirement: Add BoxList.iter_jsonl_records(records, **json_kwargs), iter_jsonl(**json_kwargs) and write_jsonl(destination, *, encoding="utf-8", **json_kwargs). Encode one record at a time with standard JSON semantics and one trailing newline, preserve Unicode/options and nested Box values, and never materialize the complete input before yielding. Reject multiline indentation, report a safe one-based record number for encoding failures, support empty input and early generator close. Write to paths or caller-owned text streams without closing caller streams; preserve existing JSON/JSONL import behavior and state that write failures may leave a written prefix.
